_comment: Opt-in predictive GPU scheduling (DD-079 predictive controller, decode target 4x), NOT in the default build: both v0.1.7 and 0.1.8-dev default to target 12 with predictive off. Use within one build: A=B=<candidate>, B_ENV="DYNALM_DECODE_PREDICTIVE=1 DYNALM_DECODE_TARGET=4" (arm a = default profile, arm b = predictive), tools/bench/ab.sh --sessions 2 --rounds 4 --warmup-rounds 1. The P1-tail gate is the hypothesis (ITL p99 30% better at 4-16 users); the others guard throughput, median ITL, first token and single-user speed. Verdicts need a 95% CI (require_ci). e2e-20261019-0022 ran this plan between v0.1.7 and the candidate without B_ENV, where the change was absent; the regression guard for that comparison is gpu-regression.json.
